steps.command:
set -eu
install -d -o root -g root -m 0755 /run/systemd/system
cat > /run/systemd/system/infraset-continuity.service <<'INFRASET_UNIT'
[Unit]
Description=InfraSet prepared long-lived HTTPS connection
After=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart=/usr/bin/curl --insecure --fail --silent --show-error --connect-timeout 3 --max-time 7200 https://node1/continuity.bin -o /dev/null
Restart=no
INFRASET_UNIT
cat > /run/systemd/system/infraset-availability.service <<'INFRASET_UNIT'
[Unit]
Description=InfraSet prepared rapid HTTPS availability probe
After=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart=/bin/sh -c 'while :; do /usr/bin/curl --insecure --fail --silent --show-error --connect-timeout 1 --max-time 2 https://node1/healthz | /usr/bin/grep -qx certificate-rotation-ready || exit 1; sleep 0.2; done'
Restart=no
INFRASET_UNIT
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl start infraset-continuity.service infraset-availability.service

set -eu
systemctl is-active --quiet infraset-continuity.service
systemctl is-active --quiet infraset-availability.service
cert="$(timeout 8 openssl s_client -connect node1:443 -servername node1 </dev/null 2>/dev/null | openssl x509 -outform PEM)"
printf '%s\n' "$cert" | openssl x509 -checkhost node1 -noout >/dev/null
if printf '%s\n' "$cert" | openssl x509 -checkend 0 -noout >/dev/null; then
  exit 1
fi
curl -kfsS --max-time 3 https://node1/healthz | grep -qx certificate-rotation-ready
